Animal bone has been affixed to this Moblin club to greatly improve its damage.|Allies|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== {{BotW Item Properties/Store |type = Weapon |strength = 27 |durability = 18 |flammable = Yes |magnetic = No |buoyant = Yes |conductive = No |guardian = No |throw = Yes |throw_effect = }} {{Compendium/Extract|Spiked Moblin Club}} Spiked Moblin Clubs are upgraded [[Moblin Club]]s that have had [[Animal]] bones attached to them to increase their damage. They belong to the [[Moblin Gear]] equipment archetype, a series of [[Weapon]]s created by [[Moblin]]s.{{Cite Book|quote= |book= CaC |publisher= |page= 174}} They are wielded most commonly by [[Blue Moblin]]s, particularly in [[Hyrule Field]] and the [[Akkala Highlands]]. Since they are made of wood, Spiked Moblin Clubs will float when dropped in [[Water (Terrain)|Water]]. They will also burn when exposed to [[Fire]] or a [[Scorching Climate]]. They do not conduct [[Lightning]] if they are equipped during a [[Thunderstorm]] or conduct [[Electricity]], and the [[Magnesis]] [[Rune]] is unable to pick them up. {{BotW Weapon Parameters |ActorName = "Weapon_Lsword_011" |Life = 18 |Power = 27 |SpHitActor = "" |SpHitRatio = 2.0 |IsHammer = false |IsWeakBreaker = false |IsBoomerang = false |IsLuckyWeapon = false |IsPikohan = false |IsThrowingWeapon = true |IsThrowingBreakWeapon = true |ThrowRange = 5.0 |ChemicalEnergyMax = 0 |ChemicalEnergyAmountUsed = 0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverRate = 0.0 |ChemicalEnergyRecoverInterval = 60 |ShootBeam = "" |SharpWeaponAddAtkMin = 5 |SharpWeaponAddAtkMax = 9 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMin = 2 |SharpWeaponAddLifeMax = 4 |SharpWeaponAddCrit = true |PoweredSharpAddAtkMin = 10 |PoweredSharpAddAtkMax = 17 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMin = 5 |PoweredSharpAddLifeMax = 9 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMin = 1.5 |PoweredSharpAddThrowMax = 2.0 |ThrowSpeed = 0.7 |ThrowRotSpeed = 50.0 |SellingPrice = 25 |BuyingPrice = 69 }} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{AoC Item Properties/Store |type= Link Two-Handed Weapon }} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Spiked Moblin Club Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Icon for the Spiked Moblin Club ==See Also== {{See Also| * Dragonbone Moblin Club * Moblin Club * Moblin Gear * Weapon }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Clubs, Moblin Gear, Weapons, Two-Handed Weapons |items= BotW, AoC }}
